mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, parent_id, user_id, content, created_at FROM comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 1 AND audit_status = 1 ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.parent_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.audit_status, c.created_at, p.title AS post_title FROM comment c JOIN post p ON c.post_id = p.id AND p.status = 1 WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM comment c JOIN post p ON c.post_id = p.id AND p.status = 1 WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.user_id = #{userId}
